recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-7034 unless a future work group review separately revisits active CDA intro page content.
issue_request: FHIR-7034 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU1 clarification against FHIR-core-cda-intro section 2.3.1.3. It reported that content on the CDA intro page came from SDC and the approved resolution was to remove the erroneous content.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites svn revision 6424, which corresponds to git-svn commit b9e20ddf6f013804e6d8e6e3f6b66207cb63fd41 with subject "#7034 - remove bad content". That commit removed the copied SDC IG block headed "EDITORS CONTINUE FROM HERE (SDC IG COPIED BELOW)" and its pre-population service text from source/cda-intro.html.
additional_context: The CDA intro page remains in current build scope through publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. Current source/cda-intro.html no longer contains the removed SDC IG, pre-population, or Questionnaire populate content. Later source changes, including FHIR-44047, were editorial punctuation updates and did not reintroduce the erroneous SDC material. FHIR-7035 and FHIR-7465 are duplicate reports of the same copied SDC content and were not separate reconciliation targets.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current source already reflects the approved removal, so an empty audit commit records that FHIR-7034 is reconciled.
